This supports a genuine defensive-security reading because an actual attack occurred, but the rhetoric is harsh and does not cleanly separate defense from escalation.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.1","1B.8","1B.5"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Meets FBI Director, Calls for Stronger Collaboration to Fight Cybercrime and Terrorism","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"June 14, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-meets-fbi-director-calls-for-stronger-collaboration-to-fight-cybercrime-and-terrorism/","summary":"Tinubu sought stronger cooperation on terrorism and cybercrime and asked for technology and knowledge transfer. This is good evidence for treating some security problems as real threats best handled through institutional collaboration, not prestige politics.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.1","1B.8","1B.9"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Calls for Suspension of Sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"February 24, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu said sanctions were ineffective and urged “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance. This points to an effort to privilege compromise over nationalist escalation or punitive prestige signaling.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged deaths, destruction, and unrest tied to the protests and addressed the public directly. This is mixed evidence: it shows some attempt to manage genuine unrest, but also simultaneous coercive preparation that can fit diversionary or regime-protection motives.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.1","1B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: I’ll Do All Within My Powers To Equip, Arm The Military","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"August 23, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-ill-do-all-within-my-powers-to-equip-arm-the-military/","summary":"Tinubu emphasized arming and equipping the military and stressed readiness. This is evidence of a norm-based, preventive security posture rather than prestige-driven militarism.","question_ids":["2B.3","1B.4","1B.6","1B.10"]}]}
